meta.title: 흐름의 지도
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (흐름의 지도, a media art exhibition (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 흐름의 지도, a media art exhibition (fictional)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Dark and deep: night navy #06070C with a faint centre glow; the lines in light blues and lilac (#7FA8FF, #B9A7FF, #8FE3E8) for the drift, blue for wind, teal for water (#2EC4B6), gold for light (#FFD27A); white type, grey-blue small print.
rationale.type: Hahmlet, a Korean serif with a calm, wide stance: light for the title made of lines, regular for the lines, letter-spacing closing in as each line fades up.
rationale.motion: Generative: thousands of particles ride a time-varying flow field, each born on its own clock and integrated from its birth to now, so every frame can be drawn on its own; they bloom from one point, gather into letters and let go, part round a visitor; the rooms change the field itself.
rationale.sound: Ambient at 96 BPM in A major (6 bars in 15 s, 12 in 30 s), pad, bell, glass and piano with a soft kick and shaker; glassy SFX: a swell into the title, chimes on the rooms.
rationale.visuals: All code: analytic fields (drift, wind, water, light), additive trails, text sampled into points for the particles to gather on, a visitor that pushes the flow aside, a clock counting this moment.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the work is silent but for the music.
